description: Free local decoding of an ERC-8021 schema-2 x402 builder-code suffix from supplied calldata. Separates application, facilitator, services and facilitator-reported metadata. No transaction lookup, receipt confirmation, identity verification or payment. Malformed and unsupported suffixes remain explicit.

calldata.description: Full caller-supplied transaction input as even-length 0x hex, at most 90,000 bytes. No URL, transaction hash, signature or receipt.

name: decode_payment_attribution
title: Decode declared application and settlement metadata
